reasons.plausibility: While the idea of using HPHT to induce a beneficial reticulated phase is possible, introducing new elements (Ti, Zr, Hf, Ta) into Al0.7CoCrFeNi without clarifying their origin creates uncertainty about feasibility.
reasons.testability: Measuring microstructure and mechanical properties pre- and post-HPHT treatment provides a straightforward way to confirm or refute the predicted phase transformation and property improvements.
reasons.usefulness: Despite the unclear compositional detail, the proposed HPHT route offers a distinctive approach to improving strength and ductility in eutectic HEAs, which could be valuable to researchers.
